description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. 
 
 
 Job Title: Agentforce Prompt and Conversation Engineer – US
Cohort: Senior Associate
Role Type: Individual Contributor 
  
 The Agentforce Prompt and Conversation Engineer will build, test, and improve AI-powered experiences that support Customer Success. This role will own prompt engineering and conversation design for Salesforce Agentforce and configure solutions in additional platforms as business needs evolve. Working from requirements established by business and product partners, this individual will translate those requirements into reliable, useful agent experiences that improve employee productivity, customer outcomes, and service delivery.
  
 Position Summary 
  
 This role combines hands-on prompt engineering, conversation design, and low-code configuration. Responsibilities span solution design, development, evaluation, release readiness, monitoring, and ongoing improvement. The role will maintain assigned prompts, conversation flows, and agent configurations, ensuring that they support defined business objectives and work effectively within Customer Success workflows.
  
 The successful candidate brings practical Agentforce experience, strong writing and analytical skills, and the ability to translate approved requirements into clear, effective interactions. They will work with business, product, platform, and technical partners to resolve implementation questions, manage dependencies, and improve solution quality. As additional platforms are selected, they will learn and apply those tools to address business requirements, primarily through low-code configuration.
  
 Responsibilities 
  
 Prompt Engineering and Conversation Design 
 Design, build, and maintain prompts and conversation flows for Agentforce solutions supporting Customer Success. 
 Translate approved business requirements into agent instructions, conversational paths, and low-code configurations with clear acceptance criteria. 
 Define how agents respond to ambiguous requests, seek clarification, maintain relevant context, and hand off to employees when needed. 
 Refine prompts and responses for clarity, accuracy, consistency, tone, and usefulness within the intended workflow. 
 Configure how agents use approved knowledge and available actions, partnering with platform and technical teams on access and integration dependencies. 
 Maintain reusable prompt patterns, conversation components, and documentation that support consistent implementation and efficient maintenance. 
  
 Solution Delivery and Platform Configuration 
 Build and configure assigned Agentforce capabilities, coordinating with Salesforce administrators and technical partners on supporting platform changes. 
 Configure solutions in additional approved toolsets as they are introduced, selecting implementation approaches that fit business requirements and platform capabilities. 
 Identify gaps or ambiguities in approved requirements and work with the responsible business or product owner to resolve them. 
 Manage assigned implementation tasks, defects, and enhancements; communicate progress, dependencies, and delivery risks. 
 Prepare solutions for testing and release, coordinate deployment through established change controls, and provide documentation and guidance for operational use. 
 Engage engineering partners when requirements exceed low-code capabilities or require custom development and integrations. 
  
 Evaluation and Continuous Improvement 
 Develop and maintain test scenarios covering expected interactions, ambiguous requests, edge cases, and unsuccessful outcomes. 
 Evaluate prompt and conversation performance against agreed criteria, including response accuracy, relevance, task completion, appropriate escalation, and user experience. 
 Test changes before release and use repeatable evaluations to identify regressions. 
 Monitor deployed agent experiences, investigate unsuccessful interactions, and refine prompts, flows, and configurations using evidence and user feedback. 
 Partner with business and product teams to assess adoption, employee productivity, service quality, and other agreed measures of business impact. 
 Apply established security, privacy, data access, and AI governance requirements throughout development and ongoing maintenance. 
  
 Typical Qualifications 
 Hands-on experience building, configuring, testing, and improving solutions using Salesforce Agentforce. 
 Practical experience in prompt engineering and conversation design for AI agents or conversational applications. 
 Experience using Salesforce low-code configuration capabilities to support business workflows. 
 Ability to translate defined business requirements into maintainable agent configurations, conversation flows, and test scenarios. 
 Understanding of generative AI behavior and limitations, including inaccurate responses, inconsistent outputs, and the need for appropriate human review. 
 Experience evaluating AI-generated responses and systematically improving prompts and conversations based on test results. 
 Strong writing and editing skills, with attention to clarity, tone, interaction design, and user needs. 
 Ability to troubleshoot issues across prompts, knowledge sources, configurations, and workflow dependencies, engaging technical partners when needed. 
 Experience supporting releases, documenting changes, and improving solutions after deployment. 
 Ability to learn new platforms and apply low-code tools to evolving business needs. 
 Strong collaboration, organization, and communication skills, with the ability to manage assigned work independently and escalate issues appropriately. 
 Familiarity with Customer Success workflows, such as onboarding, adoption, customer engagement, and retention, preferred. 
 Experience working within enterprise security, privacy, and change-management processes preferred. 
  
 
 Expected Compensation 
$119,000 - $203,000 The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job-related experience, relevant knowledge and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates.  Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package - depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans. 
  
 
 About athenahealth 
 
 Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. 
 
 Our company culture: Our talented    employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support. 
 
 Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve. 
 
 What we can do for you: 
 Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative    workspaces   — some offices even welcome dogs. 
 
 We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,   full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth   enables   employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation. 
 
 In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.
